description: An extremely fast Python type checker.

next.name: check
tip: Check a project for type errors.

option.name: --add-ignore
tip: Adds ty: ignore comments to suppress all rule diagnostics.

option.name: --color
tip: Control when colored output is used.
Possible values: auto, always, never

next.name: always
tip: Always display colors.

next.name: auto
tip: Display colors if the output goes to an interactive terminal.

next.name: never
tip: Never display colors.

option.name: --config
tip: A TOML key-value pair overriding a specific configuration option.

option.name: --config-file
tip: The path to a ty.toml file to use for configuration.

option.name: --error
tip: Treat the given rule as having severity 'error'.
Use 'all' to apply to all rules.

option.name: --error-on-warning
tip: Use exit code 1 if there are any warning-level diagnostics.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Glob patterns for files to exclude from type checking.

option.name: --exit-zero
tip: Always use exit code 0, even when there are error-level diagnostics.

option.name: --exit-zero-on-warning
tip: Use exit code 0 if there are no error-level diagnostics.

option.name: --extra-search-path
tip: Additional path to use as a module-resolution source.

option.name: --fix
tip: Apply fixes to resolve errors.

option.name: --force-exclude
tip: Enforce exclusions, even for paths passed directly on the command-line.

option.name: --ignore
tip: Disables the rule.
Use 'all' to apply to all rules.

option.name: --no-progress
tip: Hide all progress outputs.

option.name: --output-format
tip: The format to use for printing diagnostic messages.
Possible values: full, concise, gitlab, github, junit

next.name: concise
tip: Print diagnostics concisely, one per line.

next.name: full
tip: Print diagnostics verbosely, with context and helpful hints (default).

next.name: github
tip: Print diagnostics in GitHub Actions format.

next.name: gitlab
tip: Print diagnostics in GitLab Code Quality format.

next.name: junit
tip: Print diagnostics as JUnit XML report.

option.name: --project
tip: Run the command within the given project directory.

option.name: --python
tip: Path to your project's Python environment or interpreter.

option.name: --python-platform
tip: Target platform to assume when resolving types.

option.name: --python-version
tip: Python version to assume when resolving types.
Python 3.10.
Python 3.11.
Python 3.12.
Python 3.13.
Python 3.14.
Python 3.15.
Python 3.7.
Python 3.8.
Python 3.9.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Use quiet output.
Use -qq for silent output.

option.name: --respect-ignore-files
tip: Respect file exclusions via .gitignore.

option.name: --typeshed
tip: Custom directory to use for stdlib typeshed stubs.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Use verbose output.
Use -vv or -vvv for more verbose output.

option.name: --warn
tip: Treat the given rule as having severity 'warn'.
Use 'all' to apply to all rules.

option.name: --watch
tip: Watch files for changes and recheck files related to the changed files.

next.name: explain
tip: Explain rules and other parts of ty.

next.name: server
tip: Start the language server.

next.name: version
tip: Display ty's version.

option.name: --version
tip: Print version.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help.
